sn46.45:1.1: Paññavā aneḷamūgo paññavā aneḷamūgo ti bhante vuccati || Kittāvatā nu kho bhante paññavā anelamūgoti vuccatī ti || || Sattannaṃ kho bhikkhu bojjhaṅgānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā Paññavā aneḷamūgo ti vuccati || || katamesaṃ sattannaṃ || || Satisambojjhaṅgassa || la-pe || || Upekhāsambojjaṅgassa || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhu sattannam bojjhaṅgānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā Paññavā aneḷamūgo ti vuccatī ti || ||
